verdict.rationale: Edge0 has a pluggable backend facade: a new backend can implement the same interface with zero core changes, and `backends/cuda/` is a reserved slot. But the only documented backends target consumer devices (MLX on iOS, Vulkan on Windows, native Android and macOS engines), and even CUDA is only reserved, not implemented. Using TPUs or Gaudi would mean writing a backend yourself. Missing for 10: any shipped TPU, Gaudi or other datacenter-accelerator backend or plugin, documentation of the plugin/backend API, and hands-on evidence of running on specialized accelerators.
